risksForTheParent: Review classes replay and authority: Lane B is required (OWNER-RULING bound to the exact PR head). The owner rules on what the viewer lineage head means: after this unit it is the journal tip on the effective branch (the head GET /head, the correction lease and restart recovery read), not the rewind cutoff. A rewind CAS built from lineage.effectiveHead.revision now names the live tip, the value GET /head gives; before, it named the cutoff, which the lease refuses once a command has landed after the rewind.

Replay/rewind: immediately after a commit the candidate head sits AT its base, so lineage and cutoff agree (existing matchHeadRoute row); they diverge from the first command on the candidate onward, which is where the red rows measure.

Reconnect/live: the lineage revision now moves with every mirrored command (combat journal mode enabled/shadow); two lineage reads around an append differ where the cutoff never did. E2E-42 (e2e/gm-two-player-rewind.pack.spec.ts:185-186) reads host, guest and spectator lineage in one Promise.all and compares revisions; if an append lands between those reads the row would see different revisions. E2E-42 is a strict test.fail(@until-journal-cutover); whether it stays an expected failure or becomes an unexpected pass on this head is not measured here (no Playwright).

With combat journal mode off (the production constant) no match has an effective head row, so the lineage answers effectiveHead null exactly as before; the change is observable only where the journal mirrors match events.

Changed degenerate case: an effective head with no stream-head row on its branch now answers revision 0 (baseline: baseRevision); GET /head answers 404 there. Activation plants the candidate head row at its base, so this is reached only by a missing row. Not changed to null because the sentence does not say so.

The close route answers 200 { ok: true } even when it finds no host (MatchHostRegistry.closeMatch returns silently); under the module-local mutant the row fails on host.isClosed(), not on the status code.
No build, no Playwright here; any E2E proof is the parent's main proof.
